claims.claim: Rapid7 acquired Kenzo Security in March 2026 to add agentic AI security investigations to its Command Platform and stated the deal was not expected to materially affect revenue, ARR, profitability or free cash flow.
Rapid7 launched Cyber GRC generally in July 2026, extending the platform from SecOps into governance, risk and compliance workflows.

factors.name: platform expansion
factors.basis: Kenzo and Cyber GRC broaden automation and control/governance surface area.

factors.name: integration risk
factors.basis: Acquired agentic technology must integrate without eroding reliability or economics.

risks.risk: Vendor-reported AI productivity claims require independent validation before treating them as durable customer outcomes.

claims.claim: Rapid7 ended 2025 with $840M ARR, $860M revenue, $154M operating cash flow and $130M free cash flow, providing a financial baseline for 2026 platform execution.

Rapid7's 2026 threat research reports faster exploitation cycles and more zero-click/network-facing risk, supporting demand relevance for preemptive security operations but not proving company-specific monetization.

factors.name: cash baseline
factors.basis: Positive operating and free cash flow support continued product investment.

factors.name: market need
factors.basis: Threat telemetry indicates shrinking remediation windows.

risks.risk: Industry threat intensity does not automatically translate into ARR growth or durable competitive advantage.

unknowns.unknown: Current 2026 ARR growth and retention need root-owner underwriting from the latest financial filing.
